sections.title: District of Columbia estate and inheritance taxes

rows.label: Estate tax: who files and pays
rows.value: The District levies an estate tax: a DC estate tax return (Form D-76) is filed when the gross estate reaches the filing threshold for the year of death, and the tax is paid within 10 months of death
rows.note: The 2026 exclusion amount ($4,988,400) is in its own row, from OTR's notice of 1 October 2025 tax changes.
